title: Gewässerstammbaum — water records
description: One file in data/waters/. Structural rules that span files (parents exist, no cycles, every chain ends in a sea, record sits in the right file) are enforced by scripts/validate.py.

latlon.description: [latitude, longitude] in decimal degrees (WGS84). Note the order: lat first.

id.description: Unique slug, a-z 0-9 _ only, umlauts transcribed (fraenkische_saale). Homonyms get a suffix naming the parent (wuerm_amper, wuerm_nagold).

name.description: German name with umlauts; 'ss' instead of 'ß' (project convention).

parent.description: id of the receiving water (Vorfluter). null only for seas. Lakes: the water they drain into. Canals: the water their end point merges into.

side.description: Bank of the parent on which the mouth lies, looking downstream along the parent. null for lakes, seas, coastal waters and source-river pairs.

length_km.description: Total length in km; null for lakes, coastal waters, seas and where no source documents it.

length_de_km.description: Length of the German section, if different.

area_km2.description: Surface area for lakes and coastal waters.

source.description: Source (rivers), lake centre (lakes), start point (canals), inner point (coastal waters). null for seas.

mouth.description: Mouth (rivers), outflow (lakes), end point (canals), opening to the sea (coastal waters). Must lie on the parent's course.

mouth_place.description: Place of the mouth, e.g. 'Koblenz, Deutsches Eck'.

states.description: German states as ISO 3166-2:DE suffix (BE = Berlin) and foreign countries as ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 (BEL = Belgium).

historic.description: true for waterways no longer in operation (Ludwigskanal, Eiderkanal).
